name: kazhdan-lusztig-core-pyw
title: Implement and optimize Kazhdan-Lusztig core in pyw
description: Build a pyw-native Kazhdan-Lusztig core with stable semantics, bounded affine support, unified cache design, and reproducible validation.
creator: lelouch
notes: Progress recorded on 2026-04-20: refs/Kazhdan-Lusztig/Algebra.py has been structurally decomposed; pyw reuse points were mapped; semantic correction landed in pyw/core/kazhdan_lusztig.py so Q now denotes Weyl-group-element inverse KL while Q_tilde denotes coset/parabolic inverse KL; affine_bounded_Q is canonical and affine_bounded_Q_tilde is kept as a legacy alias; cache value_kind updated to Q_at_one with backward compatibility for older Q_tilde_at_one payloads. In the next implementation stage, pyw/core/affine_kl.py was added to build an affine KL workflow context from (algebra, lambda_hat, order), including bounded affine candidates, dominant Lambda search, bounded stabilizer, quotient representatives, and Weyl elements to be summed. pyw/core/kazhdan_lusztig.py now includes bounded affine coset-level Q_tilde support, and pyw/core/character.py now includes a first KazhdanLusztigCharacter implementation that assembles a grade-only character from VermaCharacter terms. Verified with sage -python -m pytest pyw/tests/test_kazhdan_lusztig.py pyw/tests/test_affine_kl_context.py pyw/tests/test_affine_kl_character.py -q --no-cov (44 passed). Additional legacy-alignment work then compared demos/Algebra.py:GetLambda against pyw step by step on D4^(1), k=-2. This isolated the first mismatch to pyw/core/affine_kl.py legacy extended-weight-lattice reconstruction, not to the Weyl prefix ordering itself. Marks for D4^(1) were corrected in pyw/core/affine_lie_algebra.py, and the legacy weight reconstruction helper was fixed enough that the D4 vacuum case now agrees with old Algebra.py through llambda, rho, llambda+rho, and the first several affine Weyl prefix actions. Separately, AffineLieAlgebra and finite_lie_algebra were expanded with dim, num_roots, num_positive_roots, and num_negative_roots, while several methods were flattened to avoid unnecessary finite_lie_algebra round-trips. Verified with sage -python -m pytest pyw/tests/test_affine_lie_algebra.py -q --no-cov (45 passed). Remaining work is to finish closing the D4 lambda_hat -> Lambda_hat regression for all three benchmark weights and then propagate the corrected GetLambda-equivalent path through the broader integral/full-affine workflow.
